subject: Re: intermittent API errors during peak window — request for relief and trial extension
messages:
From: ops@acmetech.com (Acme Tech - Ops)
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: elena.gomez@acmetech.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 500s and timeouts last night — request for credit and trial extension

Hi Naomi,

We saw a sharp increase in 500s and elevated tail latency on Redwood's hosted inference API between 02:30-03:45 PDT last night. Our ingestion pipeline retried a number of requests and this caused multiple downstream errors in production (we're running a 24/7 customer-facing feature).

We pulled basic logs and noticed spikes in p95 and a surge in long-running requests; I've attached a zipped log snippet and a short SLA snapshot. Can Redwood confirm the root cause? Given the impact to our customers, we'd like to request: 

- a one-time goodwill credit to cover the excess tokens consumed during the retry storm,
- and an extension of our 14-day trial add-on by 14 more days while we stabilize.

We're on a proof-of-concept (DEAL-48321) and this kind of incident makes our execs nervous — Elena from procurement is cc'd to keep the finance side in the loop while we investigate.

Thanks for looking into this urgently.

—Acme Ops
(attachment: acme_incident_window_logs_20270312.zip, sla-snapshot-20270312.pdf)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: ops@acmetech.com (Acme Tech - Ops)
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, elena.gomez@acmetech.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 500s and timeouts last night — request for credit and trial extension

Hi — thanks for the quick note and the logs, El and team. I'm really sorry you ran into this during a production window. We prioritize any customer-facing regressions and I want to make sure we address both the technical cause and the commercial concern.

Quick next steps from my side: 
1) Our SREs will validate the logs (I already looped Lauren) and confirm whether the event qualifies as an SLA incident.
2) If validated, I'll propose a one-time credit and a 14-day trial extension as an interim remedy; finance and sales approval will be required for any non-standard credits.
3) We'll share a brief postmortem summary and mitigation plan within 48 hours.

Can you also confirm the total estimated token consumption attributable to retries? That helps our billing team calculate a fair one-off credit.

I'll keep you updated. 

Best,
Naomi
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent 500s — Acme (DEAL-48321) — quick approval request

Looping you all for a quick approval. External thread below. TL;DR: Acme had ~75 minutes of elevated 5xxs/latency during a peak window; they want a token credit and a 14-day extension to their trial.

Notes from the SRE triage (Lauren): 
- Preliminary root cause looks like a downstream dependency saturation on our edge proxy cluster in us-west-2; traffics spikes coincided with batch job rollouts from an internal partner.
- No data exposure. Error rate peaked at ~8% for the 75-minute window; p95 increased from ~120ms to ~1.1s.
- We estimate retry-induced token consumption for Acme at ~28,000 tokens (customer reported higher, need reconciliation).

Suggested commercial offer (my recommendation): 
- One-time credit equal to 28,000 tokens (apply as account credit in billing),
- 14-day trial extension,
- A short postmortem summary and a dedicated follow-up to discuss hardening and traffic-smoothing configs (we can offer a quick consultant session).

Karthik — can you confirm this is within the standard goodwill brackets? Aditya — any objection to the consult + extension ask for a strategic POC account?

Thanks,
Naomi

--- Forwarded message ---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent 500s — Acme (DEAL-48321) — quick approval request

Thanks for the context, Naomi. 28k token credit + 14-day extension sounds reasonable for a POC customer at this stage, especially given the visible production impact and the strategic fit. Please ensure the credit is applied as a billing ledger adjustment (not a coupon) and record a line item called "incident relief - MAR12".

Aditya — no note from me unless you want to escalate. We should also include a small goodwill gesture in the form of a short, free consult (up to 2 hours) from Solutions Engineering to rebuild confidence. Lauren, can you own the postmortem and schedule the consult?

Karthik
VP Sales
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ops@acmetech.com (Acme Tech - Ops), elena.gomez@acmetech.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 500s and timeouts last night — request for credit and trial extension

Hi Maya/Elena,

Thanks again for the packet you sent. We've completed the review: our SREs confirmed the edge-proxy saturation that produced the elevated 5xxs and p95 during the window you reported. No customer data was exposed.

Resolution and actions taken: 
- We applied a one-time account credit equivalent to 28,000 tokens; you'll see this as a ledger adjustment labeled "incident relief - MAR12" in your billing view within 24 hours.
- We extended your trial by 14 days from your existing end date (new trial end: 2027-03-28).
- Solutions Engineering will reach out to schedule a 90-minute workshop to walk through traffic-smoothing best practices and an optional runbook for autoscaling.

Attached: draft billing adjustment for internal records. If you'd like us to put the consult on the calendar now, propose two 90-minute windows next week and we'll lock it in.

Apologies again for the disruption. We're committed to making this right and supporting your go-live.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
